## The heuristic

**Assume some of the heat is borrowed from the customer's own stakeholders.**


_Why:_ The person writing to us usually promised something internally on our behalf and is now exposed. Giving them something they can forward — a plain statement of status they can send onward without editing — often does more than anything we say about the fault itself.
